segments.an5.153:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
segments.an5.153:1.3: Makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto [saupārambhacitto (syā. kaṃ.)] dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto [khilajāto (syā. pī.)], duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
segments.an5.153:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
segments.an5.153:2.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
segments.an5.153:2.3: Amakkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti na makkhapariyuṭṭhito, anupārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti na randhagavesī, dhammadesake anāhatacitto hoti akhīlajāto, paññavā hoti ajaḷo aneḷamūgo, na anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
segments.an5.153:2.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattan”ti.

lines: Tatiye makkhī dhammaṃ suṇātīti makkhī hutvā guṇamakkhanacittena dhammaṃ suṇāti.
